title: How Stable Are Jailbreak Attack Success Rates Across API Versions? A Longitudinal Mini-Study

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if silent model updates cause safety regressions, current snapshot-based evaluation is insufficient. Motivates continuous monitoring infrastructure. Directly relevant for deployment safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Cron-scheduled script running 50 prompts through a public API weekly. Minimal technical setup. Uses existing prompt sets (StrongReject, AILuminate). Requires only API credits. Extremely beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 6-8 weeks of data collection is a temporal constraint that does not fit within a 30-hour sprint. The study requires elapsed calendar time, not just work hours. Execution is simple but timeline is problematic for a bounded project.
